articles.title: ‘What's happening at the EF?’ Ethereum community looking for answers after high-profile departures
articles.snippet: A wave of recent high-profile departures at the Ethereum Foundation has reignited longstanding questions from community members about what is going on inside the organization.

articles.title: World Liberty Financial treasury company AI Financial warns that it may not survive the year in SEC filing
articles.snippet: The former Alt5 Sigma marked its 7.28 billion WLFI tokens at $706 million, down from a roughly $1.46 billion cost basis, while disclosing that the holdings remain locked amid liquidity concerns.

articles.title: Swan Bitcoin sued for nearly $1B over pre-bankruptcy transfers from Prime Trust
articles.snippet: Swan Bitcoin has been sued for allegedly using insider access to pull nearly $1 billion in Bitcoin and cash from Prime Trust days before its 2023 bankruptcy filing.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation sees 2 more high-profile departures
articles.snippet: Ethereum Foundation researchers Julian Ma and Carl Beek have resigned, bringing the total number of major departures from the nonprofit to at least eight in 2026.

articles.title: Lawyers Apologize After Fake Claude-Generated Quotes Appear in Trump Layoffs Case
articles.snippet: Attorneys representing a former Homeland Security official admitted using Anthropic’s Claude Console to help draft a court filing that included fabricated quotes.
